elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies “[o]n expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Vendor must, at Customer's request, “provide transition assistance for up to six months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is provided “at Vendor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Vendor, within thirty days of the stated expiry or termination trigger, to “return all Customer Data.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Vendor must return all Customer Data “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After returning the data, Vendor must delete Customer Data from its systems and “certify the deletion in writing.”

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies “[o]n expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Vendor must provide transition assistance at Customer's request for up to six months, allowing Customer to obtain at least 90 days of assistance.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Vendor must return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days after the expiry or termination trigger, constituting the required export.
